rows.grounds: intensifying prefix su- with adjective dṛḍha; qualifies sādhakaṃ
subject, referring to the goddess previously mentioned

items.question: What assessment of the practitioner prompts the goddess to visit his abode?
premises: The practitioner is judged to be very firm.
Upon this judgment, the goddess goes to an abode.
items.inference: Recognizing the practitioner as very firm, the goddess comes to his abode.
uncertainties: The referent of ālayam could be the practitioner's dwelling or a ritual seat; context favors the practitioner's place.
items.plain_english: O practitioner, having judged the practitioner to be very steadfast, she goes to his abode.
